headline: Is your clinic losing patients after 8 PM?
sub: 5 signs you need an AI receptionist.

slides.title: Is your clinic losing patients after 8 PM?
slides.body: 5 signs you need an AI receptionist. Swipe →

slides.title: Enquiries sit unanswered till morning
slides.body: Patients message at night. By 10 AM, they've booked elsewhere.

slides.title: Your front desk is always on the phone
slides.body: Walk-ins wait while calls ring out. Someone always loses.

slides.title: Same 5 questions, all day
slides.body: Timings, fees, doctor availability. Your team repeats them hundreds of times.

slides.title: Empty slots, nobody chasing
slides.body: Signs 4 & 5: forgotten reminders and missed appointments, with no follow-up. DM "DEMO" to see it live.
